# quiet-kill-tree

> Promise-based, silent, idempotent process-tree termination for Windows and POSIX. One `await` kills a child process and everything it spawned; a pid that is already gone resolves instead of throwing, and helper processes never write to your stdio.

quiet-kill-tree is a zero-dependency Node.js package for tearing down child
process trees from dev servers, test runners, MCP servers and CLI tools. The
public surface is `killTree(pid, options)` plus its option, result and error
types.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#quick-start): install and the smallest working example.
- [Why this exists](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#why-this-exists): the Windows teardown failure it fixes, with links to the Storybook, pnpm and Playwright MCP reports.
- [Comparison](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#comparison): tree-kill, pidtree, execa and fkill side by side.
- [Migrating from tree-kill](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#migrating-from-tree-kill): callback to promise, error mapping, Windows output silence.
- [API reference](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#api-reference): options, return values, synchronous validation and error codes.
- [When not to use this](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#when-not-to-use-this): cases where fkill, pidtree, execa, process groups or cgroups fit better.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#limitations): pid reuse, orphans, zombies, and what `killed: true` actually means.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree#faq)

## Source

- [src/index.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/src/index.ts): `killTree` entry point, argument validation, in-flight deduplication.
- [src/posix.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/src/posix.ts): `ps` enumeration, bottom-up signalling, `SIGKILL` escalation.
- [src/windows.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/src/windows.ts): `taskkill /T /F`, liveness probe, exit-status classification.
- [src/errors.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/src/errors.ts): `KillTreeError`, `KillTreeAbortError` and error codes.
- [src/types.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/src/types.ts): `KillTreeOptions`, `KillTreeResult`, `NotKilledReason`.
- [src/tree.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/src/tree.ts): process-table ordering (children before parents).
- [test/index.test.ts](https://github.com/KamelotWalker/quiet-kill-tree/blob/main/test/index.test.ts): validation, deduplication and abort behavior.
